#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack and pretty-print docx XML using stdlib only (defusedxml unavailable)."""
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.dom.minidom as minidom
from pathlib import Path

input_file, output_dir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
output_path = Path(output_dir)
output_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
zipfile.ZipFile(input_file).extractall(output_path)

xml_files = list(output_path.rglob("*.xml")) + list(output_path.rglob("*.rels"))
for xml_file in xml_files:
    content = xml_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    dom = minidom.parseString(content)
    xml_file.write_bytes(dom.toprettyxml(indent="  ", encoding="ascii"))

# Summarize paragraphs with their styles and text
doc_path = output_path / "word" / "document.xml"
if doc_path.exists():
    dom = minidom.parse(str(doc_path))
    print("=== Paragraph summary ===")
    paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
    for i, p in enumerate(paras):
        pstyle = ""
        pPrs = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr")
        if pPrs:
            styles = pPrs[0].getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
            if styles:
                pstyle = styles[0].getAttribute("w:val")
        texts = []
        for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
            texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
        text = "".join(texts)
        if text.strip() or pstyle:
            print(f"[{i}] style={pstyle!r} text={text!r}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pack an unpacked docx directory into a .docx (stdlib only).

Mirrors ooxml/scripts/pack.py behavior: condenses pretty-printed XML and zips.
Also backs up the destination file before overwriting.
"""
import argparse
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import xml.dom.minidom as minidom
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path


def condense_xml(xml_file):
    """Strip whitespace-only text nodes (mirrors pack.py)."""
    dom = minidom.parse(str(xml_file))
    for element in dom.getElementsByTagName("*"):
        if element.tagName.endswith(":t"):
            continue
        for child in list(element.childNodes):
            if (
                child.nodeType == child.TEXT_NODE
                and child.nodeValue
                and child.nodeValue.strip() == ""
            ) or child.nodeType == child.COMMENT_NODE:
                element.removeChild(child)
    with open(xml_file, "wb") as f:
        f.write(dom.toxml(encoding="UTF-8"))


def validate_document(doc_path):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [
                    "soffice",
                    "--headless",
                    "--convert-to",
                    "html:HTML",
                    "--outdir",
                    temp_dir,
                    str(doc_path),
                ],
                capture_output=True,
                timeout=30,
                text=True,
            )
            if not (Path(temp_dir) / f"{doc_path.stem}.html").exists():
                print(f"Validation error: {result.stderr.strip()}", file=sys.stderr)
                return False
            return True
        except FileNotFoundError:
            print("Warning: soffice not found. Skipping validation.", file=sys.stderr)
            return True
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            print("Validation error: Timeout during conversion", file=sys.stderr)
            return False


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("input_directory")
    parser.add_argument("output_file")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_dir = Path(args.input_directory)
    output_file = Path(args.output_file)

    # Back up existing destination before overwriting
    if output_file.exists():
        backup = output_file.with_suffix(".backup.docx")
        shutil.copy2(output_file, backup)
        print(f"Backed up original to {backup}")

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
        temp_content_dir = Path(temp_dir) / "content"
        shutil.copytree(input_dir, temp_content_dir)

        for pattern in ["*.xml", "*.rels"]:
            for xml_file in temp_content_dir.rglob(pattern):
                condense_xml(xml_file)

        output_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(output_file, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
            for f in temp_content_dir.rglob("*"):
                if f.is_file():
                    zf.write(f, f.relative_to(temp_content_dir))

    ok = validate_document(output_file)
    if not ok:
        print("Contents would produce a corrupt file.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"Packed {output_file}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify final docx: all XML parts parse and headlines are underlined."""
import sys
import tempfile
import xml.dom.minidom as minidom
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

docx_path = sys.argv[1]

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    out = Path(tmp) / "check"
    out.mkdir()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(docx_path) as zf:
        zf.extractall(out)

    # 1. Every XML part must parse cleanly
    for xml_file in list(out.rglob("*.xml")) + list(out.rglob("*.rels")):
        minidom.parse(str(xml_file))
    print("OK: all XML parts parse")

    # 2. Headlines must carry underline run property
    dom = minidom.parse(str(out / "word" / "document.xml"))
    headlines = [
        "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
        "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
        "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
        "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
        "OPERATING EXPENSES",
        "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
        "RISK FACTORS",
    ]

    found = {}
    for p in dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p"):
        text = "".join(
            t.firstChild.data
            for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t")
            if t.firstChild and t.firstChild.nodeType == t.TEXT_NODE
        ).strip()
        if text in headlines:
            underlined = False
            for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
                for rpr in r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr"):
                    for u in rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
                        if u.getAttribute("w:val") == "single":
                            underlined = True
            found[text] = underlined

    for h in headlines:
        status = "underlined" if found.get(h) else "MISSING/not underlined"
        print(f"  {h}: {status}")

    missing = [h for h in headlines if not found.get(h)]
    if missing:
        print("FAIL: missing or not underlined:", missing, file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    print("OK: all headlines underlined")
